**N-acetylcysteine (NAC)** is a supplement form of the amino acid L-cysteine that boosts the body's production of **glutathione** , a key antioxidant, and helps thin respiratory mucus.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX95lrQsGCYDBGLM4h3qTJ49yy_sgeWGAgk6Fgulpyfz-_UHx9qIKFA2wObUyM2812gl5_b13cEg7rn4l7m9x6wpdyc6riuLAZj4UAAvJPr3UaIXqCmNC_OwZ-j316mlQlPCtARpbkCYQH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLRMyp3JB9785nGCmJTfLofNzXKg8TGLKk2hGumRGWsudoy4rWzhvkflGI5skHIEzANAq4j38O_tfWLyv37WXYJjstiiriGEXSsmZaGMBhGJ4fQAbL11yrYIKsOXFBrgGAdoEIIHmHrJ6)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXRvC9V380Cc0qCWvoo_vSk4WHm_FaqObDl44nnw8i2FGHLb3j0gI-_sVkFujZ7jKoUzHv9cdlMnH6CQFuyt6VT8XDg9sGU6AIspkkXnmQ7j9I9ICDdDPYQ-MjMMaHaAGDsz7b9vWSDSXU)

### How It Works & Common Uses

- **Antioxidant & Glutathione Support:** Supplies cysteine needed to make intracellular glutathione, helping counter oxidative stress and support liver detoxification.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLRMyp3JB9785nGCmJTfLofNzXKg8TGLKk2hGumRGWsudoy4rWzhvkflGI5skHIEzANAq4j38O_tfWLyv37WXYJjstiiriGEXSsmZaGMBhGJ4fQAbL11yrYIKsOXFBrgGAdoEIIHmHrJ6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX95lrQsGCYDBGLM4h3qTJ49yy_sgeWGAgk6Fgulpyfz-_UHx9qIKFA2wObUyM2812gl5_b13cEg7rn4l7m9x6wpdyc6riuLAZj4UAAvJPr3UaIXqCmNC_OwZ-j316mlQlPCtARpbkCYQH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXb7DnW5dAAXBfSALhXxYsNi_x7iKij05HOy-R40gFBSKMepTVqH-cMg_0hmLGUT31nSkmKqpcQEQK6K5i4ajPHt1n-BtBW1MSN5jpC_guA_O4wD6QICRMFLi4LjV9f2UeULAYTNgW42I)
- **Respiratory & Mucus Support:** Breaks down thick mucus; studied for chronic bronchitis and COPD, though clinical results for chronic lung conditions are mixed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF17oPJ5s9hGNtblYH_tneZLRzA8jlZn_XWi2XqOfW9zBhpvZ1wj2lO6HbNtEyd1-cYJr9Xs2nWcBp3e8JqYS26WRpng2_zHdAdr0ogviLlflQy87PelpPKwbLqyahyrMHsklc7cja_q94pVOv62Wg1f9Dzk1Ah3VLokNP8mjGvPN_HAmrf00)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLRMyp3JB9785nGCmJTfLofNzXKg8TGLKk2hGumRGWsudoy4rWzhvkflGI5skHIEzANAq4j38O_tfWLyv37WXYJjstiiriGEXSsmZaGMBhGJ4fQAbL11yrYIKsOXFBrgGAdoEIIHmHrJ6)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXRvC9V380Cc0qCWvoo_vSk4WHm_FaqObDl44nnw8i2FGHLb3j0gI-_sVkFujZ7jKoUzHv9cdlMnH6CQFuyt6VT8XDg9sGU6AIspkkXnmQ7j9I9ICDdDPYQ-MjMMaHaAGDsz7b9vWSDSXU)
- **Other Studied Uses:** Investigated as an add-on in mood and psychiatric conditions (such as depression or OCD) and immune/inflammatory support, with varying levels of evidence . (Clinically, prescription NAC is used for acetaminophen overdose and inhaled/hospital airway management.)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXMiG9CyWD6HQ1ungesp_L1_V0bczRtdTsCiJPkUetCyIUvTw9OEVm3PmogJPw0HgK1w0tHwCWspceZiOv4w4jzQGgiKPBaev4AFNJ_60U8gY6gOSpCgsk79Pi28HV6OVCFI7sh0Oiu-aErVQToYb8gHBYfYooVadl)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF17oPJ5s9hGNtblYH_tneZLRzA8jlZn_XWi2XqOfW9zBhpvZ1wj2lO6HbNtEyd1-cYJr9Xs2nWcBp3e8JqYS26WRpng2_zHdAdr0ogviLlflQy87PelpPKwbLqyahyrMHsklc7cja_q94pVOv62Wg1f9Dzk1Ah3VLokNP8mjGvPN_HAmrf00)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WRvq-FqoJnA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX95lrQsGCYDBGLM4h3qTJ49yy_sgeWGAgk6Fgulpyfz-_UHx9qIKFA2wObUyM2812gl5_b13cEg7rn4l7m9x6wpdyc6riuLAZj4UAAvJPr3UaIXqCmNC_OwZ-j316mlQlPCtARpbkCYQH)
- **Typical Oral Dosages:** Commonly taken at **600 mg to 1,800 mg daily** (studied across a wider range of 300 mg to several grams per day depending on context).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXRvC9V380Cc0qCWvoo_vSk4WHm_FaqObDl44nnw8i2FGHLb3j0gI-_sVkFujZ7jKoUzHv9cdlMnH6CQFuyt6VT8XDg9sGU6AIspkkXnmQ7j9I9ICDdDPYQ-MjMMaHaAGDsz7b9vWSDSXU)

### Side Effects, Interactions & FDA Status

- **Side Effects:** Usually mild digestive issues like nausea, upset stomach, vomiting, or diarrhea; rash or allergic/bronchospasm reactions can occur.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF14QgWRMRtMW4BMa3_UaRzO-Kz_Blpl0mQXRG8rgnmIbETE45Ems3hRYIVCDu03nYgQ63MYFSisdFaPw-WqwTeQa6S7_tqbWp0IKTgXM4n43D5ehXNMsnyPJyy_xqnTRDC9zQ_tL9pRmHQDzhXLLop8FFFMivRhQPKmx6dYb1iYlfEP4NNiRhN9iC)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXMiG9CyWD6HQ1ungesp_L1_V0bczRtdTsCiJPkUetCyIUvTw9OEVm3PmogJPw0HgK1w0tHwCWspceZiOv4w4jzQGgiKPBaev4AFNJ_60U8gY6gOSpCgsk79Pi28HV6OVCFI7sh0Oiu-aErVQToYb8gHBYfYooVadl)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXRvC9V380Cc0qCWvoo_vSk4WHm_FaqObDl44nnw8i2FGHLb3j0gI-_sVkFujZ7jKoUzHv9cdlMnH6CQFuyt6VT8XDg9sGU6AIspkkXnmQ7j9I9ICDdDPYQ-MjMMaHaAGDsz7b9vWSDSXU)
- **Interactions & Precautions:** Can interact with nitrates (such as nitroglycerin, risking severe low blood pressure and headache) and pirfenidone, and may affect blood clotting. Consult a doctor before use if pregnant, nursing, taking medications, or managing asthma/chronic conditions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF14QgWRMRtMW4BMa3_UaRzO-Kz_Blpl0mQXRG8rgnmIbETE45Ems3hRYIVCDu03nYgQ63MYFSisdFaPw-WqwTeQa6S7_tqbWp0IKTgXM4n43D5ehXNMsnyPJyy_xqnTRDC9zQ_tL9pRmHQDzhXLLop8FFFMivRhQPKmx6dYb1iYlfEP4NNiRhN9iC)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXMiG9CyWD6HQ1ungesp_L1_V0bczRtdTsCiJPkUetCyIUvTw9OEVm3PmogJPw0HgK1w0tHwCWspceZiOv4w4jzQGgiKPBaev4AFNJ_60U8gY6gOSpCgsk79Pi28HV6OVCFI7sh0Oiu-aErVQToYb8gHBYfYooVadl)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXRvC9V380Cc0qCWvoo_vSk4WHm_FaqObDl44nnw8i2FGHLb3j0gI-_sVkFujZ7jKoUzHv9cdlMnH6CQFuyt6VT8XDg9sGU6AIspkkXnmQ7j9I9ICDdDPYQ-MjMMaHaAGDsz7b9vWSDSXU)
- **Regulatory Status:** While NAC was historically approved as a drug, the [FDA](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF17sb1Xn9wtoqw0xoN5rtCoD506HT9155YqQgb_MVuQmCraiaRrG801WhZQ5Ue-PzsaADCoUwJ4B120HsIzW15BvXw22I59uvt_mGXLmZqlxMHy9HnkWljGWvDYTECZafwfmpWwqDHxi5_lAC4Yc7BweZJvZWAKZqnfDbEyB0tZ-EWuVm-_7OBhpyt1iJeDu-bd_Jt6JY5ZaDNcEpaiWctbTJi9cHWYTurkJvSp7Vkllk) issued final guidance in 2022 outlining enforcement discretion for certain NAC-labeled dietary supplements that meet statutory requirements.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF17sb1Xn9wtoqw0xoN5rtCoD506HT9155YqQgb_MVuQmCraiaRrG801WhZQ5Ue-PzsaADCoUwJ4B120HsIzW15BvXw22I59uvt_mGXLmZqlxMHy9HnkWljGWvDYTECZafwfmpWwqDHxi5_lAC4Yc7BweZJvZWAKZqnfDbEyB0tZ-EWuVm-_7OBhpyt1iJeDu-bd_Jt6JY5ZaDNcEpaiWctbTJi9cHWYTurkJvSp7Vkllk)

For more details on uses, dosing, and safety, see [WebMD](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXMiG9CyWD6HQ1ungesp_L1_V0bczRtdTsCiJPkUetCyIUvTw9OEVm3PmogJPw0HgK1w0tHwCWspceZiOv4w4jzQGgiKPBaev4AFNJ_60U8gY6gOSpCgsk79Pi28HV6OVCFI7sh0Oiu-aErVQToYb8gHBYfYooVadl).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXMiG9CyWD6HQ1ungesp_L1_V0bczRtdTsCiJPkUetCyIUvTw9OEVm3PmogJPw0HgK1w0tHwCWspceZiOv4w4jzQGgiKPBaev4AFNJ_60U8gY6gOSpCgsk79Pi28HV6OVCFI7sh0Oiu-aErVQToYb8gHBYfYooVadl)

### Example Options

- **Nutricost N-Acetyl L-Cysteine (NAC) 600mg, 180 Capsules** : Provides 600 mg of vegan N-acetyl L-cysteine per capsule with standard capsule excipients for straightforward daily dosing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF14QgWRMRtMW4BMa3_UaRzO-Kz_Blpl0mQXRG8rgnmIbETE45Ems3hRYIVCDu03nYgQ63MYFSisdFaPw-WqwTeQa6S7_tqbWp0IKTgXM4n43D5ehXNMsnyPJyy_xqnTRDC9zQ_tL9pRmHQDzhXLLop8FFFMivRhQPKmx6dYb1iYlfEP4NNiRhN9iC)
- **Thorne NAC - N-Acetylcysteine (90 Capsules)** : Provides 500 mg of N-acetyl-L-cysteine per capsule from a brand that notes third-party testing for purity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXb7DnW5dAAXBfSALhXxYsNi_x7iKij05HOy-R40gFBSKMepTVqH-cMg_0hmLGUT31nSkmKqpcQEQK6K5i4ajPHt1n-BtBW1MSN5jpC_guA_O4wD6QICRMFLi4LjV9f2UeULAYTNgW42I)
